articles.title: England secure historic away win against Spain under Tuchel
articles.summary: England delivered an incredible performance to defeat Spain away from home, marking their finest display yet under the management of Thomas Tuchel. The match proved to be a thrilling encounter that showcased both dominance and resilience from the visitors against the world champions in this major international fixture.

articles.title: Aberdeen appoint Mario Frick as their new head coach
articles.summary: Aberdeen have officially announced the appointment of former Liechtenstein striker Mario Frick as their new head coach. Frick takes over the managerial position at the club, bringing his football experience to lead the team moving forward in their upcoming competitions and league matches.

articles.title: Ronaldinho makes professional football comeback at age 46
articles.summary: Brazil legend Ronaldinho made a surprise return to professional football at the age of 46, playing the first half for Ravenna in an Italian third-tier derby against Forli. The iconic playmaker stepped back onto the pitch for 45 minutes, adding another chapter to his illustrious career.

articles.title: Arsene Wenger opts against running for FIFA presidency
articles.summary: Arsene Wenger has decided not to challenge Gianni Infantino for the FIFA presidency. This choice provides a significant boost to Infantino's campaign as he aims to secure a fourth term leading world football's governing body without facing opposition from Wenger.

articles.title: Manchester United target Premier League defenders in transfer gossip
articles.summary: Manchester United are reportedly interested in securing Fulham defender Calvin Bassey alongside Brentford's Nathan Collins. Additionally, transfer rumors indicate that AC Milan are pursuing a loan deal for Real Madrid's Endrick as clubs begin lining up potential targets.

articles.title: Chapecoense air crash survivor Alan Ruschel retires after promotion
articles.summary: Alan Ruschel, one of the six survivors of the tragic 2016 Chapecoense plane crash, has officially retired from professional football. He concluded his career on a high note by helping his team achieve promotion to Brazil's Serie A in his final ever match.

articles.title: Andy Robertson celebrated as Scotland's finest captain
articles.summary: Andy Robertson has surpassed Kenny Dalglish's appearance milestone to cement his legacy as Scotland's greatest ever captain. While debates surrounding the nation's best players continue, Robertson's incredible journey and leadership set him apart as he reaches his landmark cap haul.

articles.title: Denmark thrash Portugal as Norway defeat Wales
articles.summary: Portugal suffered a heavy 4-1 home defeat against Denmark in the Nations League during their first match following Cristiano Ronaldo's international retirement. Rasmus Hojlund scored twice to lead the Danish side to victory, while Wales dropped to the bottom of Group A4 after losing to Norway.

articles.title: Portugal immortalise Cristiano Ronaldo's number seven shirt
articles.summary: Portugal have made a permanent change to their national team setup by preserving the original design of the number seven shirt. This special tribute honors Cristiano Ronaldo's remarkable international legacy, which includes 146 goals across 246 appearances before his retirement.

articles.title: Ten-man England hold off Spain to top Nations League group
articles.summary: England secured a famous 3-2 victory against Spain, withstanding a fierce comeback from the world champions despite playing with ten men following Elliot Anderson's red card. The hard-fought win ensures Thomas Tuchel's side finishes at the summit of their Nations League group.

articles.title: Mirra Andreeva wins WTA Finals title without dropping a set
articles.summary: Mirra Andreeva completed an outstanding week of tennis by defeating Elina Svitolina to claim the WTA Finals championship. Andreeva dominated the tournament from start to finish, securing the prestigious title without dropping a single set throughout the entire competition.
